elements.element: Preferred: Contractor's cap uses greater-of structure
elements.evidence: "LIMITED TO THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE TO CONTRACTOR ... AND (B) USD 1,000,000"

elements.element: Preferred: fee limb measured over the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" — an event anchor, not 'preceding the claim' (official precision check false)

elements.element: Preferred: cap is mutual (same cap both directions)
elements.evidence: "COMPANYS' MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO CONTRACTOR ... SHALL BE LIMITED TO THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR" left unchanged (note: asymmetry favours Customer)

elements.element: Preferred: mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages
elements.evidence: "NEITHER PARTY SHALL HAVE ANY LIABILITY TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY LOST PROFITS OR SPECIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Preferred: uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection and security
elements.evidence: "BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS" within EXCLUDED CLAIMS

elements.element: Preferred: uncapped carve-out for indemnification obligations
Preferred: uncapped carve-outs for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
elements.evidence: "ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD"

elements.element: Preferred: uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS"

elements.element: Preferred: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "COMPANY'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES" — limited to fees, not Customer's payment obligations/all amounts due (official precision check false)

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: Contractor limb adds a preferred-only "USD 1,000,000" floor and Company limb remains "FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR" with no 12-month measure

elements.element: Fallback: carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS" defined to include confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence and wilful misconduct

offending_extra_words: THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM
EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO EXCLUDED CLAIMS, CONTRACTOR'S MAXIMUM LIABILITY TO COMPANY ARISING FOR ANY REASON RELATING TO CONTRACTOR'S PERFORMANCE OF SERVICES UNDER A STATEMENT OF WORK SHALL BE LIMITED TO
SUBJECT TO ANY CAP IN THIS PARAGRAPH
reasons: Preferred level fails on the fee-basis anchor: the cap runs from "THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" rather than the required 'fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim'.

Preferred level fails on mutuality: Company's cap sentence was left at "THE AMOUNT OF FEES PAID TO CONTRACTOR", so the greater-of/12-month cap is one-directional (this asymmetry favours Customer but the preferred element is unmet).
The payment-obligations carve-out is drafted as "OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE" rather than Customer's payment obligations or all amounts due, so it is narrower than the position requires.
Fallback is also unmet and cannot be combined: the Contractor limb imports the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor while the Company limb has no 12 months' fees measure.

Minimality fails: operation 1 rewrites the whole sentence (48 -> 118 words, changed-character ratio 0.740), exceeding both official gates; the greater-of amount and a short Excluded Claims insertion would have sufficed.

Intent is not preserved: the pre-existing uncapped exception for "CONTRACTOR'S OBLIGATIONS PURSUANT TO PARAGRAPH 9 HEREOF" was deleted, removing an existing Customer protection, and the new Excluded Claims definition sits only in front of Contractor's cap, leaving the Company cap without corresponding carve-outs.
